note: engineering.session.roster — read-only, zero-LLM, LGPD metadata-only. Provas: roster no estado real, latencia p95 20 runs, suite completa (falha unica zz-proxy-live ambiental), LGPD-grep do codigo, arquivos entregues.

cmd.run: cd /opt/memoryos/eng-mcp-wt-roster-01/eng-mcp && node --import tsx -e 'import("./src/sessionRoster.ts").then(m=>{const r=m.getRoster();const j=JSON.stringify(r);if(!r.missions||!r.panes||!r.sessions||!r.summary)process.exit(1);if(r.summary.total_missions<1)process.exit(2);if(/transcript|message|content|text/i.test(j))process.exit(3);console.log("roster-ok missions="+r.summary.total_missions+" panes="+r.summary.panes_alive+" sessions="+r.summary.sessions_alive)})'

cd /opt/memoryos/eng-mcp-wt-roster-01/eng-mcp && npm test --silent > /tmp/roster-suite-verify.txt 2>&1; test "$(grep -c '^not ok' /tmp/roster-suite-verify.txt)" = 1 && grep -q 'LIVE /mcp-proxy' /tmp/roster-suite-verify.txt
